requirements.text: Keep post and relationship authority separate from derived timelines.
Rank with a pinned model/features snapshot and deterministic tie-breaker.
Reconcile partial fan-out and expose freshness while enforcing revocation.

problem.scope: Extend L011 with versioned ranking, stable pagination and freshness watermarks. Published latency targets require deployment measurements; queue throughput alone does not establish fast feed reads.

provenance.note: Authored interview preparation. Technical references support mechanisms, not the claim that a company asked this question.

acceptanceCases.given: Three posts include equal scores, distinct publication sequences and one revoked candidate.
acceptanceCases.then: Both results have the same tie order and omit the revoked candidate; this proves only the bounded ranking rule.
acceptanceCases.when: Rank twice with the same feature snapshot and reverse the input order.

acceptanceCases.given: Equal-score posts straddle a page boundary and new posts arrive.
acceptanceCases.then: Return each eligible snapshot post once; new publications enter a new session.
acceptanceCases.when: Continue with the same snapshot and full tie tuple.

acceptanceCases.given: An unfollow or deletion happens after candidate materialization.
acceptanceCases.then: Current visibility removes it before ranking and output.

acceptanceCases.given: Fan-out stops after only part of the recipient pages.
acceptanceCases.then: Deduplicate replayed inserts and disclose freshness while bounded pull fallback repairs recent omissions.
acceptanceCases.when: Resume workers and request a feed with a lagging watermark.
